details:
The ability to dynamically load and unload the visibility of entire sections of a world is critical to the largest worlds on VRChat, but is currently held back by the performance of Udon and limited access to the Unity API.

Having native VRC Unity components for detecting the player’s presence in a ‘player sector’ and a component for controlling the visibility of world objects in a ‘world sector’ would not only improve performance for larger worlds, but significantly decrease the download size of worlds by completely eliminating the need for baking occlusion culling data entirely.

There are already systems that do this in my own worlds, and even in Udon they perform dramatically better than occlusion culling alone. Given that there are many other VRC components which are very use-case specific and similarly or more complex to use in their own ways, it seems reasonable to add this to the roadmap since it’s rather attainable, and could only benefit more players from refinement.
title: World Sector System
